blocks.text: Planning Your Weekend Open House Route in Maple Ridge, BC

parts.t: Every listing at the top of this page has an upcoming public open house scheduled on the MLS®, typically hosted on Saturday and Sunday afternoons between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM. To make the most of a 2-to-3-hour window, group your tour geographically: start in Southwest and West Central near Maple Meadows Station, move through East Central (Town Centre), and finish in Cottonwood, Albion, or Silver Valley.

Remember that the agent hosting an open house represents the seller under BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA) agency rules. If a home catches your eye—or if the scheduled weekend time doesn't work for you—we can book a private showing at your convenience and pull the Property Disclosure Statement (PDS), title search, and strata or permit history before you write an offer.

blocks.text: What to Check When Touring Open Houses in Maple Ridge

parts.t: While walking through an open house in Maple Ridge, look beyond staging: check the age plate on the furnace and hot water tank, inspect window seals and attic/roof lines, note driveway slope and street parking (especially in compact Albion, Cottonwood, and Silver Valley subdivisions), and listen for train or road noise near Lougheed Highway, Dewdney Trunk Road, or the CPKC rail corridor.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Maple Ridge Open Houses This Weekend

parts.t: When are open houses usually held in Maple Ridge?

Most public open houses in Maple Ridge take place on Saturday and Sunday between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM or 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM, with occasional twilight open houses on Thursday evenings. This page updates automatically from the live MLS® feed.
Do I need to pre-register to attend a public open house in Maple Ridge?

No pre-registration is required for a public MLS® open house—you can walk in during the posted hours. However, if you prefer a private walkthrough or want to see homes that do not host public open houses, we can book private appointments any day of the week.
Who does the hosting agent at an open house represent?

Under BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA) rules, the agent hosting an open house represents the seller (the listing brokerage) and owes fiduciary duties to the seller. Having your own buyer's agent protects your negotiation strategy and due diligence at no extra fee.
How should I route a weekend open house tour across Maple Ridge?
Can I get the strata documents or Property Disclosure Statement after an open house?

Yes. Send us the address or MLS® number of any open house you visit and we will pull the Property Disclosure Statement (PDS), title search, BC Assessment history, and—for condos or townhomes—the full strata document package.
Why do some Maple Ridge listings not hold public open houses?
Many occupied family homes, tenanted properties, and rural acreages in Websters Corners, Thornhill, and Whonnock are shown by private appointment only rather than public open houses.
